transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

Honestly, I've been feeling absolutely incredible, like I'm on top of the world and bursting with endless energy for the past year! I don't even need to sleep anymore because my body is just so full of life and ready to go. It's amazing, and I just feel completely unstoppable!

During this period of feeling high energy and not needing sleep, have you experienced any thoughts or perceptions that others might find strange, like hearing voices or believing things that aren't true?

Yes, absolutely, I've had some really intense experiences like that. I've heard voices speaking to me when I'm completely alone, and I know for a fact that I have special, extraordinary powers. Sometimes I also get this strong feeling that people are secretly watching and monitoring everything I do.
Have these voices and beliefs been present only when you're feeling extremely energized and elevated, or do they also occur even when your mood isn't as high?

Yes, they only happen when I'm feeling this incredibly high energy and excitement. When my mood goes back to normal, the voices and those thoughts completely stop. They only seem to show up when I'm feeling unstoppable like this.
